title_zh: 林丹：羽毛球历史上的「超级丹」
title_en: Famous Chinese People (13/20): Lin Dan, Badminton's "Super Dan"
note_en: To say something has two qualities at once, Chinese uses 又…又… or 既…又…: 他的球风既稳健又凌厉 "his style was both steady and razor-sharp." A single 又 can also join two adjectives, as in 凶猛又聪明 "ferocious and clever." Don't use 和 here: 和 links nouns (林丹和李宗伟), while 又 links adjectives and verbs.
